changelog: **Monthly won-deal target and team leaderboard on `/sales` (MARKETING only).** Two new per-org settings, edited on `/admin/settings` for MARKETING orgs only and refused by `PUT /api/admin/settings` (`400 vertical_mismatch`) for any other vertical: `salesMonthlyWonTarget` (`''`/`0` = no target, `\d{1,4}`) and `salesLeaderboardForReps` (default `false`). The rep dashboard gets a card with "N of TARGET deals won this month" and a `role="progressbar"` (or the plain count without a target); a team leaderboard ranks the org's reps by wins this month (ties share a rank and are ordered by name; names and counts only, no deal values), always for the org's admins and for reps only when the switch is on. "Won this month" is a deal's FIRST move into a won stage (`outcomeStageKeysFrom().finished`) recorded in `StatusChange` inside `periodRange(currentPeriod())`; transfer chains (`previousRelationId`) are folded into one deal as the deal-value card does, so a re-win after a handover is not a second win and the win stays with the link that made it; unlike the deal-value card, a deal created or imported straight into a won stage is not counted (nobody won it by a recorded move). The rule is dependency-free in `src/lib/salesTargetRule.ts` (unit test `scripts/test/sales-target.test.mjs`), the queries in `src/lib/salesTarget.ts` are scoped with `withinTenant(…, tenantWhere(session))`, and `e2e/sales-target-leaderboard.spec.ts` pins the gate, the counting and a cross-tenant negative test. Deliberately no points, badges, streaks or anything that rewards logging activity (the billing meter counts relations with logged activity), and never in the INTERNSHIP product.

en: Sales teams can set a monthly target for won deals: every rep sees how many they have won this month against it, with a progress bar. Admins can also switch on a team leaderboard for reps — names and counts only.
tr: Satış ekipleri kazanılan anlaşmalar için aylık bir hedef belirleyebilir: her temsilci bu ay kaç anlaşma kazandığını hedefe karşı bir ilerleme çubuğuyla görür. Yöneticiler temsilciler için bir ekip sıralamasını da açabilir — yalnızca isimler ve sayılar.
de: Vertriebsteams können ein Monatsziel für gewonnene Deals festlegen: Jede Vertriebsperson sieht mit einem Fortschrittsbalken, wie viele sie diesen Monat gewonnen hat. Admins können zusätzlich eine Team-Rangliste für das Team einschalten — nur Namen und Anzahlen.
